integrity: The proof reduces the claim to the published suffix-structure theorem and an exact signed-incidence invariant of the source morphisms. The invariant and exponential block-length growth are independently replayed by the bundled verifier; the infinite limiting argument is analytic.
scientific_limitations: The result controls only the one-letter frequency and gives no bounded-discrepancy or finite-balance conclusion. The constants in the quantitative bound depend on the suffix supplied by the structural theorem, and no claim is made for rich words outside the strict 14/5-free regime.
title: Uniform half-density in every \(14/5\)-free binary rich word
